items: 🎯【Ultra Mini Design, Free Up Your Car Space】 Featuring a revolutionary ultra-slim design that's 50% smaller than conventional adapters. Crafted with upgraded nano-composite materials, this feather-light yet durable carplay wireless adapter blends perfectly with any vehicle's interior while delivering truly seamless smart connectivity.

⚡ 【Wireless Freedom, Lightning-Fast Connection】 Easily convert wired CarPlay to wireless - no cables required. Equipped with a advanced Bluetooth 5.2 communication chip, pair once and enjoy instant auto-reconnect every time you start your car - no waiting!

🚀 【Dual-Band Chipset, Smooth Performance】 2.4GHz + 5GHz dual-band ensures 100% faster transmission with near-zero latency for smooth navigation, music, and calls. Enjoy a pleasant trip with wireless Apple CarPlay adapter.
❄️ 【Smart Cooling, Stable Performance】 Innovative dual-ventilation cooling design of carplay wireless adapter prevents overheating, ensuring stable performance even on long driving.

💎 【Universal Compatibility, Plug & Play】2 in 1 Wireless carplay adapter for iPhones (iOS 10+) and Android phones (Android 11+), compatible with 98% of vehicles with OEM wired CarPlay or Android Auto. Includes both USB-A and USB-C adapters for all cars. Automatically adapts to vehicle screens and support split screen display.

🌌 【Secure Fit, No Shaking or Disconnection】 Creative exterior design seamlessly aligns with the majority of automotive USB ports. Having undergone rigorous vibration testing, which guarantees a stable connection even in severe driving conditions.

💡 【Important Note】 Before purchasing, please confirm your car comes with OEM wired CarPlay and OEM touchscreen (❌ Don't supports OEM wireless CarPlay cars). How to make sure if your car models support CarPlay? ①Enter Apple official Website ②Type 'CarPlay available models' in the search bar ③Check if your car model is included.

🛡️【Lifetime Updates & Worry-Free Support】 FCC/CE certified with lifetime free updates. Backed by 180 Days Warranty and 24/7 Technical Support Lifetime for Free. If you encounter any problems during use, please don't worry, contact us directly!
